visualCharacteristics: A page title banner with an optional background image, a heading and an optional lead line. Variants add a login card, a picture hero or a grey CTA box beside the title.
contentPattern: Row 1: optional picture(s), an h1/h2 heading and an optional lead paragraph. Optional row 2 (aside): heading paragraph, logo picture, note, CTA paragraphs (<strong> = orange, <em> = blue) and plain text links.
usage: Use at the top of a page to show the page title, optionally with a background image and a side login or CTA box.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for page-top title banners; pick banner-slider for rotating promotional images or hero for full marketing heroes.
